run_PerfCheckRunner_benchmark: run a PerfCheckRunner benchmark to compare inference settings against an fp64 baseline on default systems
run_run_inference_single: run inference on a single benchmark system with a checkpoint and InferenceSettings to get energy and forces
compare_compare_results: compare a candidate InferenceResult against a baseline InferenceResult to compute energy and force error metrics
format_format_report_table: format a dictionary of benchmark results into a human-readable table string with error and performance columns
create_InferenceResult_dataclass: create an InferenceResult dataclass to store energy, forces, stress, and optional performance metrics from inference
